target_customer: Developers and companies that want to use AI models or retrieval without exposing user data
problem: Sending sensitive data to AI providers exposes it. Blyss first offered private retrieval using homomorphic encryption, then confidential AI inference in GPU secure enclaves.
business_model: Developer API and hosted confidential AI service (private beta); pricing not found

founders.name: Samir Menon
education: Stanford, BS and MS computer science, 2019
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: homomorphic encryption research with Dan Boneh.

founders.name: Neil Movva
education: Stanford, BS and MS electrical engineering, 2019

exit.reason: YC lists Inactive; the website still advertises a private beta and no shutdown notice was found.

competitors.name: Enveil
competitors.what: Encrypted privacy-focused search and analytics using homomorphic encryption
competitors.traction_then: enterprise customers per press; details not read

competitors.name: Sunscreen
competitors.what: Fully homomorphic encryption tooling startup for crypto and Web3

technical_complexity.rationale: Homomorphic encryption private retrieval was published at a top security venue per the founders, and later GPU enclaves with browser attestation require deep cryptography and systems skills.

defensibility.rationale: Cryptographic expertise is rare, but confidential computing on GPUs became available to larger vendors.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Cloud providers and Duality later added confidential GPU AI offerings, e.g. Duality with Google Cloud confidential GPU VMs in Nov 2025.

market_need_then: Rising use of third party AI models in 2023 raised data privacy concerns; the YC page frames it as the same shift Signal brought to messaging. No customer numbers found.

branding.domain_note: Uses blyss.dev. A USPTO BLYSS word mark filed Aug 2022 belongs to an unrelated Houston company and is marked dead.

identity.voice_and_tone: Security-first, developer-facing, compares itself to Signal and WhatsApp

brand_strength.rationale: Open-source SDK on GitHub gave some developer visibility, but no press about the brand was found.

pivots.from: Homomorphic encryption SDK for private key-value retrieval
pivots.to: Confidential AI in GPU secure enclaves
pivots.why: Not sourced; YC page and website show both products. Date is approximate.

outcome_analysis: Blyss joined YC in Winter 2023 with a private retrieval SDK and later pivoted to confidential AI in GPU enclaves. It raised about $500K per databases, and YC now lists it Inactive. No source gives a reason or shutdown, one co-founder appears to have moved to another company, so the cause is not public and no failure factors are assigned.
notes: The $500K round rests on databases only: CB Insights gives a convertible note on 2023-02-22, Caplight an accelerator entry on 2023-04-05, VCBacked a pre-seed dated April 2023. Pivot date is approximate. Website blyss.dev was live and shows a private beta.
